motive.canonical: The killer felt they had built their success on their own merit, and the victim’s planned exposure wasn't just professional sabotage—it was an attack on their fundamental identity and years of struggle. They believed eliminating the threat was the only way to protect their precarious social standing.

method.canonical: Blunt force with the Brass till weight, in the storage room.

opportunity.canonical: Mitchell Thorne was at the cafe's rear door during the murder window and lied about being at the fountain.

explanation: The investigation pivots away from departmental jealousy and romantic conflict, focusing instead on the complex financial documents found at the scene. It becomes clear that {VICTIM_ID} was not merely involved in a professional rivalry but was gathering irrefutable evidence of {KILLER_ID}'s systematic embezzlement and ethical malfeasance regarding the shared project. The confrontation escalated when {KILLER_ID} realized their meticulously constructed façade of success was about to collapse. Driven by desperation, they used the decorative item—the {WEAPON_NAME}—to silence the threat permanently, believing that protecting their reputation required eliminating the source of the exposure.
